title: Mobile Wallet Fee Schedule
content:
The Mobile Wallet transfer fee is set by principal band; each band is inclusive at both ends. Funding-method fees, the pay-by-bank discount and the first-transfer promotion are tier figures listed below for every tier. Amounts are USD.

## Transfer fee bands

| Tier | Principal band (USD) | Transfer fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Mobile Wallet Micro | 5.00 to 100.00 | 0.99 |
| Mobile Wallet Economy | 10.00 to 999.99 | 1.99 |
| Mobile Wallet Economy | 1000.00 to 2999.00 | 2.99 |
| Mobile Wallet Express | 10.00 to 499.99 | 2.99 |
| Mobile Wallet Express | 500.00 to 999.99 | 3.99 |
| Mobile Wallet Express | 1000.00 to 2999.00 | 4.99 |
| Mobile Wallet Express Plus | 50.00 to 999.99 | 2.49 |
| Mobile Wallet Express Plus | 1000.00 to 2999.99 | 3.49 |
| Mobile Wallet Express Plus | 3000.00 to 5000.00 | 4.49 |
| Mobile Wallet Priority | 10.00 to 999.99 | 4.99 |
| Mobile Wallet Priority | 1000.00 to 2999.00 | 6.49 |
| Mobile Wallet Large Amount | 1500.00 to 5000.00 | 7.99 |

## Funding-method figures

| Tier | Credit-card funding fee (percent of principal) | Debit-card funding fee (USD, flat) | Pay-by-bank fee discount (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mobile Wallet Micro | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Mobile Wallet Economy | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Mobile Wallet Express | 3.00 | 0.00 | 1.00 |
| Mobile Wallet Express Plus | 3.00 | 0.00 | 1.00 |
| Mobile Wallet Priority | 0.00 | 0.00 | 1.00 |
| Mobile Wallet Large Amount | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

- The credit-card funding fee is a percentage of principal for credit-card funding; it is 0.00 on a tier that does not accept credit cards.
- The pay-by-bank fee discount is the amount taken off the band fee for pay-by-bank funding, never below 0.00.

## First-transfer promotion

| Tier | Transfer fee waived on a first-ever personal transfer | Largest principal the promotion covers (USD) | Margin on a promoted first transfer (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mobile Wallet Micro | no | 0.00 | 1.95 |
| Mobile Wallet Economy | yes | 1000.00 | 0.00 |
| Mobile Wallet Express | yes | 500.00 | 0.00 |
| Mobile Wallet Express Plus | no | 0.00 | 1.30 |
| Mobile Wallet Priority | no | 0.00 | 1.55 |
| Mobile Wallet Large Amount | no | 0.00 | 0.95 |

A promotion cap of 0.00 means the tier has no first-transfer promotion.

## Worked figures (hypothetical transfers)

- Mobile Wallet Express, principal 499.99: band fee 2.99. Principal 500.00: band fee 3.99, because 500.00 opens the next band.
- Mobile Wallet Express, principal 500.00 paid by pay-by-bank: the band fee 3.99 less the 1.00 discount gives 2.99.
- Mobile Wallet Micro, principal 60.00 paid by pay-by-bank: the band fee 0.99 less a 0.00 discount stays 0.99.
